This phone leaves the group for good: your family stops getting anything from it, and its old entry stays in their list until an admin removes it. Everything on this phone is deleted: the group, the whole history and the settings. To come back, an admin has to invite this phone and you pair it again from the start. This cannot be undone.

Your screen time is sent to all parents in your family group, including any who join later. Now:

What is sent: screen time per day and per app, time per hour, the number of unlocks, app names and icons, and events: pauses, stopped sync, a hidden notification, usage access or location turned off. With the sync through a parent\'s Yandex Disk, also where this phone is: its last place, its route today and when it leaves or enters a safe zone.
Sharing is off: nothing new is sent, and your family sees that.
Only a parent can change sharing: from their phone, or with the parent PIN in More → Sync on this phone. If something is turned off in Android settings, your family sees it.
Parents\' phones keep the data as long as their settings say (by default 90 days in detail and a year of daily totals).

Pause: your time is kept and sent once you resume. Stop: this phone stops reaching the family; your time is kept too. Your family sees both.
History kept on this phone, diagnostics, disconnecting this phone
Off. When on, your family\'s data also travels through your Yandex Disk. The developer stores nothing.

Confirm the access in the browser. If it shows a code, paste it here.

Update Kinsight on every phone of the family, then turn the cloud on.

Hand the storage to another parent
That parent signs in to their Yandex account on their phone, and the family\'s data moves to their Disk. A parent who is not an admin yet becomes one.
Waiting for %1$s to take the storage
A phone left the group. Sign in to Yandex to give the family a new access to the Disk.
The family\'s storage is now on your Yandex Disk.
The storage cannot be taken over right now.
Sync through Yandex Disk turns off. The data stays on the phones, and Bluetooth goes on working.
First hand the storage to another parent (Yandex Disk, above).
The owner role is moving to the new phone.
The new phone is the owner now. This phone leaves the group by itself.
The storage is moving to another Disk. You can disconnect this phone once every phone has switched to it. A phone that no longer syncs can be removed from the group.
To move to a new phone, first restore access to the Disk: sign in to Yandex on this phone.
Turn off sync through Yandex Disk
Turn off sync for the whole family?

Every phone of the family stops syncing through your Yandex Disk, and Kinsight gives up its access to your Disk. Children\'s location is no longer shared. The data stays on the phones, and Bluetooth goes on working. The family folder stays on your Disk: you can delete it there yourself. Any admin parent can turn the sync on again by signing in to Yandex.
The sync was turned off. The family folder stays on the owner\'s Yandex Disk until it is deleted there.
The sync was not turned off. Try again.
Your parents will see where this phone is and learn when it leaves a safe zone. Location access is needed.
Turn on “Use precise location” for Kinsight: safe zones need the precise location, the approximate one is not enough.
Choose “Allow all the time” so your family sees the location while Kinsight is closed.
